item.summary: In line with Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi's vision of 'Sahkar se Samriddhi' , transparency, accountability, good governance and institutional strengthening in the cooperative sector are being continuously promoted under the leadership of Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah. item.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah visits the Regional Office of the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies (CRCS) in Pune and reviews its functioning and progress of various initiatives
